For a 50-person Indian company, these are three currently available TMC-style options. Public pricing is limited, so the actual commercial quote needs verification.

Option	Price	Reliability / support	Important limitations
EaseMyTrip EMTDesk	₹0 service/convenience fee advertised; travel fare extra	24/7 support, corporate dashboard, policy/expense controls 
EaseMyTrip
+1
	Confirm fare markup, offline-agent fees, credit terms and cancellation handling
FCM Travel India	Custom quote	24/7 human support, dedicated consultants/account management, global inventory 
FCM Travel
+1
	Enterprise-oriented; pricing/implementation fees aren't publicly disclosed
Corporate Traveller India	Custom quote	SME-focused sister brand of FCM; local/global support 
FCM Travel
	Quote required; confirm India-specific service fees and after-hours support

Purchase terms to verify: per-booking fee, GST/input-credit handling, cancellation/reissue fees, credit period, unused-ticket tracking, hotel markups, emergency support, and implementation cost.

Practical shortlist: EMTDesk for transparent low-fee entry; FCM/Corporate Traveller if you need a more managed programme.

+1
